content:
sarah: Heads-up — we just launched a beta of the new community plugin marketplace for redwood-adapters (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-adapters). This is a curated place for community-contributed model adapters, tokenizers, and small tooling that make it easier to plug models into Redwood runtimes.

sarah: What’s included in the beta:
- A publishing guide and contributor checklist (CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Automated CI that runs inference smoke-tests for every PR (:ci-bot: runs them)
- A lightweight CLI to discover and install adapters: `pip install redwood-adapters && rwd-adapter search`
- A maintainer program — we’re onboarding volunteer maintainers for review and compatibility checks

sarah: Quick notes for teams: adapters are runtime-annotated (quantization/profile metadata) so they should pick the best kernel/path automatically. Backwards-compatible by default, but see migration notes in the repo for edge cases.

sarah: Call to action: if you publish or use adapters, please: 1) star the repo, 2) try the CLI on a small model, 3) nominate yourself or someone for the maintainer program (link in repo). We’re running a Community Plugin Day next Friday where contributors can pair with Eng DevEx to get PRs across the finish line. :tada:

matt: congrats, awesome to see this. question — will these adapters be usable on Dedicated/Private, or only hosted for now?

sarah: Good Q — adapters are distribution-agnostic. The adapter metadata includes compatibility flags (hosted | dedicated | private). The CI runs smoke-tests against a small Dedicated-like binary to validate runtime hooks. For Private, customers will need to sync the adapter package into their repo or private package index.

raj: Community ops note: I’m sending out a calendar invite for Plugin Day (Fri 2026-03-27 10:00-14:00 PT). We’ll have pairing slots with Eng DevEx and a short maintainer onboarding session at 11:00. RSVP in the invite.

ci-bot: build 2497 — tests green, release tag v0.9.0-beta published to GH releases (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-adapters/releases/tag/v0.9.0-beta) :white_check_mark:

leah: I can volunteer as a maintainer for tokenizer adapters. happy to take initial PR reviews next week.

evan: Are there any changes to the public Redwood API surfaces we should be aware of (call signatures, model selection)?

sarah: Short answer: no breaking API changes for the Redwood inference REST/SDK. The adapter infra sits as an orthogonal package that the runtime queries for model metadata. We do have a small new header `X-Adapter-Source` for observability (opt-in). Migration notes in repo explain how to enable/disable.

raj: Cross-posting to the community discord + our contributors channel. Will also run a short AMA during Plugin Day.

sarah: Thanks everyone — if you’re interested in helping review or want a pairing slot, reply here or add yourself to the Maintainers board on the repo. :rocket:
